newsitem.title: USA: Royal Bancshares to buy back shares.
newsitem.headline: Royal Bancshares to buy back shares.

text.p: Royal Bancshares of Pennsylvania said Monday it approved a resolution authorizing the company to repurchase up to four percent of the outstanding shares of the company's Class "A" common stock for the period commencing on February 1 and ending on February 1, 1998.
The company said aggregate purchases are not to exceed $5,000,000 and/or 329,177 shares.
During 1996, Royal Bancshares of Pennsylvania said it repurchased 198,113 of its shares at a cost of $2,025,874.
Royal Bancshares of Pennsylvania is the parent company of Royal Bank of Pennsylvania, a community bank with thirteen offices in southeastern Pennsylvania.
